prompt:

| Return 3m            | -3.3% |
| Return 1m            | +0.9% |
| Return 1w            | +2.2% |
| Range position (63d) | 50% |
| 21d realized vol     | 19% |
| Last close           | 62.97 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows mixed medium-term performance with a modest short-term uptick (1W +2.2%, 1M +0.9%) but negative 3M momentum (-3.3%). Its price sits mid-range (50% range position) with moderate volatility (21d realized vol ~19%), suggesting limited near-term catalysts and no clear breakout. Overall, neutral to mildly positive sentiment for the next 20 trading days implies a HOLD.

DECISION: HOLD
